revalidatedFindings.subject: Live native children and bitmap annotations
revalidatedFindings.finding: RNMapbox MarkerView and MapLibre Marker declare live children; Android annotations convert children to bitmaps. MapLibre iOS Marker delegates to ViewAnnotation. These paths do not establish equivalent physical touches.

revalidatedFindings.subject: Offsets and anchors
revalidatedFindings.finding: RNMapbox declares normalized anchors and no MarkerView offset. MapLibre converts named anchors and scales Android offsets by density. Web marker anchors are read during construction, while setter-backed fields update. The proposed update/reset contract remains pending.

revalidatedFindings.subject: RNMapbox child gesture containment
revalidatedFindings.finding: stopGesturePropagation defaults to false and is documented for Android. Preserve nested child interaction; the missing MapLibre wrapper option does not prove SDK impossibility.

revalidatedFindings.subject: Selection and dragging
revalidatedFindings.finding: MapLibre Marker selected is documented for iOS. Native live markers declare no draggable prop; annotations declare dragging. RNMapbox supplies a decoded GeoJSON feature, MapLibre supplies nativeEvent.lngLat, and web supplies an SDK LngLat. Native live dragging requires investigation.

revalidatedFindings.subject: Annotation helpers
revalidatedFindings.finding: Both native annotation helpers compose animated point sources and layer children. Source/Layer composition must preserve requested animation and press handling.

revalidatedFindings.subject: Popup dismissal/cleanup
revalidatedFindings.finding: Native callouts attach to annotations whose iOS callouts require a title. Callout has no standalone onClose. Both web wrappers detach the close listener before teardown removal. The agreed requested-dismissal/unmount distinction is preserved; native composition remains proposed.

revalidatedFindings.subject: Popup update differences
revalidatedFindings.finding: The Mapbox wrapper assigns anchor in the branch for a changed truthy offset; MapLibre assigns it in the anchor/maxWidth branch. Closing and focus options initialize SDK construction. Proposed updates and resets require independent tests.

revalidatedFindings.subject: Callout styling
revalidatedFindings.finding: RNMapbox style applies to the animated wrapper and containerStyle to the native container. MapLibre style applies to the native container and animatedStyle to its wrapper. RNMapbox textStyle versus MapLibre titleStyle needs an explicit conversion.

revalidatedFindings.subject: Controls and ornaments
revalidatedFindings.finding: MapLibre Android documents scaleBarPosition as top-left only. MapLibre web exports Terrain/Globe/Logo controls that Mapbox web omits. IControl.onAdd returns a DOM element; native wrappers declare no browser control host. Navigation options initialize construction; ScaleControl updates unit/maxWidth.

revalidatedFindings.subject: Registry ownership
revalidatedFindings.finding: react-map-gl useMap returns a named collection plus current. Implemented one-map-react useMap(id) returns a singular common ref and throws explicit missing-context/map errors. Its usage example type-checks; camera command success remains pending.
